resources.string: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or authorized by the gym.
Hold positions and problems were compiled by climbers from public videos. They may not match the wall, and the set may have changed. Trust what you see at the gym.
“How different bodies climb it” is a model’s projection, not coaching advice. It does not promise a move is possible or safe.
Grade bands come from the colored strip on each problem’s tag. They are not a grading verdict.

Everything is free · no purchases · no subscription · no ads
The pose model ships inside the app. No model downloads, no account, no cloud AI. Imported videos and analysis stay inside the app and are excluded from system cloud backups.

33 keypoints drive the skeleton replay and in-frame geometry. Angles are 2D projections; the hip trail is not your physical center of mass. Occlusion, camera movement and other people in frame all affect results. Check every cue against the original video.
Works with videos of one climber, whole body in frame, from a fixed camera: 0.5–180 seconds, up to 500 MB each. Trim anything else in your gallery app first.
This build has no gym data. The gym model, problems and climbing simulation ship with the released app, not with the public source code.
You can delete the video and analysis from each record. Uninstalling the app removes local records. Use Share to keep notes you want.
